The '''Farnica system''' was located in the [[Interior Region]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Novi system/Legends|Novi]] and [[Sivoria system/Legends|Sivoria systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Farnica [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the origin point of the art form known as the [[Farnican chime-painting]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|77|''Idyll''}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Farnican chime-painting]]|system=Farnica [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Farnica system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
